{{Quote|Lekern Renald is the station chief in Sobrik, the Imperial settlement where you landed. He runs Intelligence operations on Balmorra and can brief you more thoroughly.|Watcher Two briefs Cipher Nine over Balmorra|<ref name="BtE" />}}
'''Station chief''' was a position in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the empire, station chiefs were assigned to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] by [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]] or the [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watchers]] and tasked with maintaining order, monitoring local populations, reporting suspicious activity, containing local threats, and supporting the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith]], [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]], and [[Ministry of Logistics]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Imperial station chief [[Lekern Renald]] assisted Imperial agent [[Cipher Nine]] during [[Operation: Blackout]] to dismantle a terrorist cell on the war-ravaged world [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I got word from the sector station chief. Said he got a call from Ki Sazen. She wants to join us.|Player choice-dependent dialogue between Ardun Kothe and Cipher Nine after a mission on Taris|<ref name="TaL" />}}
The position of station chief appeared in the Imperial Agent class story in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="BtE" />
